records.title: EXPENDITURE BY COMPANIES UNDER CSR
details:
The Minister replied as under
Sir, as the Chairman, you
have said it, I can take it as a
suggestion and see what
best I can do.

records.title: DIRECT INTERNATIONAL FLIGHTS FROM PATNA AIRPORT
details:
On behalf of the Central Government, I can say that we will find solution as
early as possible. We are also working towards a solution so that not only from Patna airport
but also from other airports, let us say, from Bihar, the Gaya Airport, the international
operations will increase.

records.title: FOUR LANING OF NH - 139
details:
In the annexure referred to in
reply to parts (a) to (c): SI
No.1:- Preparation of
Detailed Project Repoit (DPR)
for 4-laning is awarded. SI
No. 2:- It was inter-alia stated
that Work in Bihar portion is
in progress, SI No. 3:- The
stretch from Saristabad
(Patna) - Phulwari Sharif
Naubatpur is already 4-laned
and proposal for 4-laning of
Naubatpur to Hariharganj is at
DPR Stage.
